error.title: Output Module
error.detail:
### __Detailed Info__ (optional)
Format, codec, file name and frame numbering of the Render Queue item are compared with the presets configured in `ayon+settings://aftereffects/publish/ValidateOutputModule`.
Frame sequences need AE's `[#####]` token, not a printf pattern such as `%05d`.

error.title: Output file name
error.description:
## Output file name does not match the product name
Output Module {index} of '{comp_name}' writes '{actual}', but the product is '{product_name}'.
{problems}
### How to repair?
Rename the file in the Render Queue `Output To` field, or change the file name pattern of the preset in `ayon+settings://aftereffects/publish/ValidateOutputModule`.

error.title: Output extension
error.description:
## Output extension is not allowed
Output Module {index} writes '{actual}', expected {expected}.
{problems}
### How to repair?
Change the format in the Output Module, or add the extension to the preset in `ayon+settings://aftereffects/publish/ValidateOutputModule`.

error.title: Frame numbering
error.description:
## Frame numbering does not match the format
Output Module {index} writes '{actual}'.
{problems}
### How to repair?
Use a `[#####]` token in the file name for frame sequences, and a plain name for single file formats. Or change the preset in `ayon+settings://aftereffects/publish/ValidateOutputModule`.
